pages.text: 201 9  Resolutions       Res # Date  Signed Title Description 201 9 -01 Initiated but not completed Resolution for the Girdwood Mountain Bike Park master plan 201 9 -02 2 / 25 /1 9 Support for the KMTA Girdwood Parks and Rec Grant application Parks and Rec application for tools and trail building equipment matching grant. 201 9 -03 3/18/19 Support for KMTA Girdwood Bear Aware Grant application Girdwood Bear Aware application for Bear Aware material matching grant. 201 9 -04 3/18/19 Support for a variance from AMC21.07.020B.9 at 119 Stowe Road Variance from new stream setback ordinance for  reconstruction on the lot.  B uilding pad and driveway  will be  within the  new  setback , however new  structures  will be outside of it , resulting in an overall improvement.  201 9 -05 3/1 8 /1 9 Support for Construction of Phase 2 of the Girdwood Iditarod National Historic Trail Resolution to move forward with phase 2, from Ruane Rd to  Karolious , on the existing trail alignment.   201 9 -06 4/15/19 Support for Girdwood Area Plan Update Committee, as an entity separate from government, to update the existing Girdwood Area Plan in accordance with AMC 21.03.130 Previously GAP was a subcommittee of GBOS, however in order to qualify for funding and to ensure the GVSA and MOA roles as a stakeholder, it is necessary to become a fully grassroots entity  201 9 -07 5/21/19 Support for The Herbal Cache LLC Marijuana Retail Store License An existing entity with solid history in Girdwood, the Herbal Cache has changed ownership, which requires new Resolution for licensing 201 9 -08 5/21/19 Support for Amendment to AMC 21.09.050C.2 relating to Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUS) Recommendation from Housing Working Group to amend code regarding ADUs to loosen conformity requirements. 201 9 -09 6/17/19 Support for Secure Trash Ordinance AO2019-74(S) and request that Municipal Manager and Assembly designate GVSA as a Secure Trash Regulation Zone Outcome of Girdwood Bear Aware group is trash regulation, requiring bear resistant cans.  This resolution supports Secure Trash Regulation Zones and requests that GVSA is designated as one of them.   201 9 -10 7/19/19 Support for KMTA  grant  GTC  Application GTC application is for trail and interpretive signage on the Beaver Pond Trail, in conjunction with Eagle Scout service project. 201 9 -11 8/26/19 Support for renaming the Alyeska Ball Field in honor of  Sladen  J  Mohl Girdwood role model and avid ball player was killed in accident while attending at college in California,  support for re naming the ball field  “ Sladen  J  Mohl  Memorial Field”.   201 9 -12 8/2 3/19 Support for AK DOT application for Alaska Community Transportation Program (CTP) Grant Funds Alyeska Highway and bike path work completed in 2016 left community with issues that are  on-going  but DOT has no funds to address them.  This resolution gives DOT support to apply for CTP grant to address these issues in their Right of Way.   201 9 -13 8/21/19 Support for GVSA application for Alaska Community Transportation (CTP) Grant funds Same grant as 2019-12 however this is for GVSA to work on roads in its right of way on Arlberg Rd and the Arlberg pedestrian path. 201 9 -14 10/22/19 and 11/18/19 Support for Girdwood  Community Building to be funded through municipal bond in the spring 2020 municipal election Resolution to remove existing community buildings in the Girdwood Park, which house Little Bears Playhouse and the Glacier City Hall (old fire hall/garage) and replace them with one building, to be leased by Little Bears.  Resolution was amended the following month to add  that preservation of the history of the uses of the buildings will be incorporated in the new building.   201 9 -15 10 /22/19 Support for contract for Police Services with City of Whittier and Whittier Police Department Public Safety Committee recommends contracting with WPD for another  3 year  contract period, with 2-1 year extensions. 201 9 -16 10/2 8/19 Support for GVSA purchase of GFR equipment from the GFR 406 capital account Required to keep step with AFD for interoperability,  Self Contained  Breathing Apparatus (SCBAs), Rapid Intervention Crew (RIC) packs, air compressor to be purchased from GFR savings account.   201 9 -17 11 /18/19 Support for Construction of Phase 2 of the INHT Updated resolution for use on the Recreational Trails Program (RTP) grant application. 201 9 -18 11/ 20/19 Support for Huddle AK to be awarded sole source contract for Girdwood Trail Plan As Huddle AK is familiar with Girdwood and involved in GAP, Cemetery and other plans, GTC wants Huddle AK to be awarded sole source contract in order to move forward swiftly on Girdwood Trail Plan.  Other options are to put the RFP out to bid, which takes significant time; or to run this through an existing term contract, which has been discouraged by MOA Purchasing as it appears a pass-through. 201 9 - 19 12/17/19 Support code change to allow food and beverage kiosks (food trucks) in gC10 by adding a “P” to gC10 21.09-2: Table of allowed uses In process of expanding the brewery to the full building in its current location, MOA Planning discovered that food trucks are not currently permitted in area zoned gC10.   201 9 - 20 12/17/19 Support for no parking signs on one side of  Garmish  and Echo Ridge Parking engineer supports no parking on both sides, neighbors have requested just one side of the streets be designated no parking.
